category_title: Children with communication difficulties and reactive behavioral outbursts
minimal_context: Angus is having a one-to-one conversation with his teacher to recount an incident that happened in the playground.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Angus, tell me what happened in the playground.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking very quickly and getting over-excited) They were over there and then... and then he came up and... it was just...

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't... wait. He took it and then... I don't know what I was saying! (Looks highly flustered)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to explain it to me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't! (Gets visibly annoyed, kicks the chair leg, and turns away, refusing to continue the conversation)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Angus, tell me what happened in the playground.

STUDENT: (Speaking very quickly and getting over-excited) They were over there and then... and then he came up and... it was just...

TUTOR: Keep going, what else happened?

STUDENT: I don't... wait. He took it and then... I don't know what I was saying! (Looks highly flustered)

TUTOR: Just try to explain it to me.

STUDENT: I can't! (Gets visibly annoyed, kicks the chair leg, and turns away, refusing to continue the conversation)

task.content: Trying to tell me something that happened in the playground.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When he is not coping and loses track of the conversation.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Get annoyed or just not continue the conversation... often violent as a consequence.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Struggles to express himself with adults and peers alike.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Seriously lacks confidence in his academic work.
